intro.title: A Calm & Refined Sanctuary in the Heart of the Aegean
intro.p1: Nourla Boutique Hotel was born in Urla, where warm Aegean breezes meet centuries-old olive orchards. Our architectural restoration harmonizes traditional stonework with modern minimalism and Mediterranean warmth.
intro.p2: With only 10 individually designed suites, we offer our guests more than a stay: an elevated lifestyle rhythm that restores the senses, integrated with gastronomy and nature.

about.hero_title: Not a place, a state of mind.
about.who_title: The breeze of Urla doesn't just blow
about.who_p1: It tells a story through stone, tree, sea, and time.
about.who_quote: "NoUrla is the brand for those who choose to stop within this story."
about.who_p2: Each room is not the result of a design idea but a continuation of a feeling of life. Natural textures, clean lines, and carefully selected details exist not for show, but for peace.
about.who_p3: Because NoUrla is more than a hotel — it's a living experience.
about.blockquote: Born from a philosophy that stays outside the crowd, doesn't rush, and chooses simplicity over show.
about.blockquote_sub: Here every detail is a choice; every corner a stance, every touch carries intention.
about.kitchen_title: Born not from a recipe, but from a geography
about.kitchen_p1: Here you don't sit at an ordinary table — you feel a geography.
about.kitchen_p2: Here food is not prepared; the story of what comes from the earth is completed. We set out with a culinary philosophy that respects the earth's gifts, listens to the seasons, and chooses the right over the excess.
about.kitchen_quote: "At NoUrla, flavour comes not from show, but from simplicity."
about.kitchen_sub: In every plate lives Urla's breeze, the shade of olive trees, the freshness of spring, the patience of Urla's vineyards and the calm of the Aegean.
about.value1_desc: An experience that reminds you that simplifying without settling is possible.
about.value2_desc: A place to calm without leaving the city, to deepen without approaching nature.
about.value3_desc: Carries the character of the land it's named after. Sincere but reserved, elegant but bold.
about.exp_p1: NoUrla is an experience that reminds you that calming without leaving the city, deepening without approaching nature, and simplifying without settling are all possible.
about.exp_p2: It carries the character of the land it's named after. Sincere but reserved, elegant but bold, calm but strong.
about.exp_quote: "Everyone who comes here slows down a little. Looks a little more carefully. Feels a little more real."
about.closing_tag: Because NoUrla is not a place
about.closing_h2:
Where less is valued,
Where silence is heard,
Where you'll find yourself valuable,
Where time doesn't rush…
about.closing_quote: NoUrla. Here everything is exactly as it should be.

guest_stories.title: Moments at Nourla
guest_stories.subtitle: Every stay is unique. Here are the unforgettable experiences our guests share most.
guest_stories.story1_excerpt: Discover ancient vineyards with our sommelier, taste rare production wines. An afternoon that becomes a lifetime memory.
guest_stories.story2_excerpt: Breakfast prepared with fresh-picked olives, tomatoes and herbs every morning. 94% of our guests name it their favourite.
guest_stories.story3_excerpt: Private boat trips to the turquoise coves of Çeşme. Swimming in crystal waters and a sunset return.
